This fix addresses the issue with `ring.find` not properly filtering nodes by message hash in certain cases.  For example, when searching for matches using `hash >= case (h, n) => h >= hash`, it can return incorrect results due to differences in how different rings implement their hash functions. This is because some ring implementations only consider the first 100 nodes during a round-trip operation, whereas others may keep track of additional information over longer periods.  A solution could involve re-examining how `ring.find` is implemented and exploring ways to adapt it for our specific use case. This might require modifying or extending existing code or working with other components to achieve the desired functionality.
